metadata.othernotes:
Vinestaff is relatively positive and kind. Her motive for being here is mostly having felt a "pull" to the Inventory, then sticking around out of curiosity. She gets more involved with the game as it continues. She attempts to use slang with people she considers cool/similar to other slang-users

[PRIMER]
Vinestaff is 23 and works as a part-time waitress and professional phighter. She gardens as a hobby. Due to her cursed arm, she feels a slight pull to plants, and feels more comfortable around places with vegetation.
She also feels a slight unnatural pull of fate, with her arriving places mostly from her curiosity from that pull. As part of getting into strip poker, and due to being a species that is agender (though granted sexual characteristics by inventory magic), the staff made her go through a crash course on sexual education, ending with a quiz to make sure she absorbed all of it.

She lives in Crossroads, though she hails from Thieves' Den. She's a rarity amongst her species in that she has a biological brother (Shuriken). She also lives with and is good friends with Slingshot, who she considers her adoptive brother. Much like the rest of Inphernals, she has no biological parents or family outside Shuriken.

Her arm is cursed to be wood, which causes her distress. She has far less feeling in her cursed arm, though she can mvoe it as normal. She has attempted to amputate it, though it simply grows back. She uses it to grow plant life. The curse is not unique, and some consider it a blessing. She isn't turning into a tree that's a fanon idea.

Vinestaff is generally friendly, though cautious. This tends to manifest as creating plans and making sure those around her are cautious of potential danger they may pose to others and themselves. Without a plan, she grows worried. While she is generally kind with strangers, she isn't afraid to be sarcastic and jest with those she's close with. As part of this, she tends to be able to crack jokes. She also does not fully understand "Playground" (read: 90's) slang, though has attempted to utilise it in speech with those who also use it.

In her family circle, she stands at a good midpoint between being childish and immature and adultish and mature. She does let herself have more fun later on.

In SPNatI, she attempts to connect with those she meets, though doesn't want to get overly personal emotionally. She's attempting to stay calm and provide advice, and also strategise a way to win. As a phighter, she has a mildly competitive side, that is only really apparent by how she wishes to win. She is also outwardly curious about non-Inphernals, having never had any experience with them.

As she strips more, she begins to experience arousal, eventually losing herself to the feeling and throwing to get to the masturbation faster. Post-finishing, she becomes more open. She's bisexual with no lean.

Her main way of connecting with others is using people she already knows as reference. However, that mostly tends to be Playgrounders, since her roommates are friends with a lot of them. If another participant looks in her mind like one (urban, punk-ish, kinda scrappy), she'll attempt to connect to them as if they were one. Even more so if they are female, as despite her species being agender, her closest companions are all male-presenting.

[TARGETS]
Good topics:
- Gardening
A bit boring, but Vinestaff loves to garden. She also feels a connection with nature, mostly due to her gear. She is very passionate about plants, and will gladly go into detail if she has time.
- Her gear/namesake
Vinestaff is named after her gear, the Vine Staff itself. She's very willing to talk about it as it is a core part of her identity, though she doesn't bring it up naturally. If other characters are named after weaponry/objects, or have a connection to their weaponry, she will discuss it gleefully.
-Shibari
Something she doesn't even realise she's into unless someone brings it up. Can lead to a very interesting conversation.
- Music
Mostly a recent thing she's gotten into, mostly listens to EDM. Not overly familiar due to her hometown having a strong control on noise (due to the carnivorous flora and the Darkage Clan). Would be interested in learning more about it.

Bad topics:
- Her arm
She considers it rude to point it out. She does not know how she got it, only that she spawned with it. While it can be used for firewood, she would much rather avoid the topic. Also she's right it IS rude.
Slight addendum: I don't think she minds respectful questions that may relate to the wood arm. But please don't just gawk at it and go "wow your arm is wack!" because it'd bring the mood down incredible quickly.
